summary: Keep Yahoo and Proton HTML quoted history from changing the current RFI/Submittal Email workflow context.
decision_refs: The active goal requires accurate and adaptable RFI/Submittal/Email handling
A synthetic Yahoo-wrapped historical RFI Question currently changes a current Response to MIXED
Open-source Odoo and UnquoteMail recognize yahoo_quoted and protonmail_quote boundaries
approval_evidence: The persistent user goal explicitly requests continued accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
known_limitations: Only exact wrapper classes are added; no language-dependent quote heuristic or automatic mailbox access is introduced.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no customer Email, mailbox, provider or paid model is used.
